newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca jumps amid bear squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca jumps amid bear squeeze.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group climbed on Friday to their highest point since early November as ongoing takeover speculation and the recent depreciation in sterling sparked a bear squeeze, dealers said.
By 0945 GMT, the shares were up 13p to 1736-1/2, having risen as high as 1750 earlier, even as the FTSE 100 tumbled some 0.75 percent.
"It's just more of the same and we're seeing a bit of a bear squeeze," said one dealer.
The shares got a big boost yesterday by takeover talk and also by a sharp retreat in the British pound.
Concerns that the strength of the currency would cut into profits have weighed on Zeneca shares for months as about 94 percent of the pharmaceutical concern's sales are outside the U.S.
